facts.fact: Finance law 23-019/AU (adopted 27 November 2023) appropriates KMF 194,457,800 for 2024 to the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, with no capital; the August 2024 rectificative revised it to KMF 682,681,240.
facts.system: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, budget 2024

facts.fact: The ministry's 2024 appropriation of KMF 194,457,800 is lower than the 2023 rectified figure of KMF 337,232,800 (down KMF 142,775,000, 42.34%), as printed in the law.
facts.system: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, budget 2024

facts.fact: The FY2024 budget execution report of 14 March 2025 shows the ministry spent KMF 183,586,075 in 2024 (salaries 41,223,675; goods and services 2,362,400; transfers 140,000,000), 94.41% of the original appropriation and 26.89% of the revised KMF 682,681,240.
facts.system: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, execution 2024

note: Ministry envelope also covers posts; the execution figures come from the record's stage history of the 2025 report.
